legend: Tim the Busy Beaver has signed up for a pistol class in order to pass their PE requirement and wants to be an elite marksman. The MIT shooting range has N$$$N$$$ (1≤N≤3⋅105)$$$(1 \leq N \leq 3 \cdot 10^5)$$$ lanes numbered from 1$$$1$$$ to N$$$N$$$. Lane i$$$i$$$ currently has Ai$$$A_i$$$ (0≤Ai≤5⋅105)$$$(0 \leq A_i \leq 5 \cdot 10^5)$$$ targets lined up in a row. It is guaranteed that there is at least one target in the entire range.

Tim's practice gun has an infinite number of bullets, and he needs to shoot down every target. Before each shot, Tim will pick a lane and fire 1$$$1$$$ shot down that lane. Once a target is hit, it will be knocked down and will never come back up.

However, Tim's aim is terrible, so every odd-numbered shot will hit the first target in the lane, while every even-numbered shot will miss the first target in the lane and hit the second one (if it exists). The first shot is shot 1$$$1$$$.

Tim is not allowed to fire a shot that does not hit any target, as it would damage the wall behind the targets. Help Tim find a sequence of shots that will knock down every target, or state that no such sequence exists.
input: Each test contains multiple test cases. The first line contains a single integer t$$$t$$$ (1≤t≤1000)$$$(1 \leq t \leq 1000)$$$: the number of test cases. The description of the test cases follows.

Each of the t$$$t$$$ testcases consists of 2$$$2$$$ lines. The first line contains N$$$N$$$, the number of lanes. The second line contains N$$$N$$$ spaced integers A1,A2,⋯,An$$$A_1,A_2,\cdots, A_n$$$, indicating the number of targets in each lane.
It is guaranteed that the sum of Ai$$$A_i$$$ across all test cases is no more than 5⋅105$$$5\cdot 10^5$$$.
It is guaranteed that the sum of N$$$N$$$ across all test cases is no more than 3⋅105$$$3 \cdot 10^5$$$.
output: For each testcase, output "YES" if there exists a sequence of shots that hits every target, or "NO" if no such sequence exists. You can output the answer in any case (upper or lower). For example, the strings "yEs", "yes", "Yes", and "YES" will be recognized as positive responses.

Let A$$$A$$$ be the sum of Ai$$$A_i$$$ in the testcase (note that A$$$A$$$ may be different for different test cases). If such a sequence exists, output on a separate line a sequence of A$$$A$$$ space-separated integers l1,l2,⋯,lA$$$l_1,l_2,\cdots, l_A$$$, where li$$$l_i$$$ is the lane that Wabbit should fire the i$$$i$$$-th shot at. If there are multiple solutions, print any of them.

You will receive 50%$$$50\%$$$ of the points for each subtask if the YES/NO responses are correct, but the provided values of li$$$l_i$$$ are not. For each testcase, you must output exactly A$$$A$$$ values of li$$$l_i$$$ for partial credit.
(30$$$30$$$ points): The sum of N$$$N$$$ across all test cases does not exceed 2000$$$2000$$$, and the sum of Ai$$$A_i$$$ across all test cases does not exceed 2000$$$2000$$$.
note: In the first test case, there is only 1$$$1$$$ lane with 3$$$3$$$ targets, and Wabbit can knock down all targets by firing 3 shots at lane 1$$$1$$$. If the targets are A,B$$$A,B$$$ and C$$$C$$$ from front to back, the first shot will knock down A$$$A$$$, the second shot will miss B$$$B$$$ and knock down C$$$C$$$, and the last shot will knock down B$$$B$$$.

In the second test case, there is only 1$$$1$$$ lane with 2$$$2$$$ targets. The first shot at lane 1$$$1$$$ will hit the front target, but the second shot will not knock down the remaining target as it will miss. Thus, no sequence of shots exists for this test case.

In the third test case, there are 5$$$5$$$ lanes with 1$$$1$$$ target each. The first shot at any lane will hit the target at that lane, but the second shot will not be able to hit any other target. Thus, no sequence of shots exists for this test case.

legend.ai: 忙碌的海狸 Tim 报名参加了手枪课程，以满足体育课要求，并希望成为一名精英神枪手。MIT 射击场有 N$$$N$$$ (1≤N≤3⋅105)$$$(1 \leq N \leq 3 \cdot 10^5)$$$ 条编号从 1$$$1$$$ 到 N$$$N$$$ 的射击道。第 i$$$i$$$ 条射击道上目前有 Ai$$$A_i$$$ (0≤Ai≤5⋅105)$$$(0 \leq A_i \leq 5 \cdot 10^5)$$$ 个目标排成一列。保证整个射击场中至少有一个目标。
Tim 的练习枪拥有无限发子弹，他需要击落所有目标。每次射击前，Tim 会选择一条射击道，并向该射击道射出 1$$$1$$$ 发子弹。一旦目标被击中，它就会倒下，并且不会重新立起来。
然而，Tim 的准头很差，因此每次奇数编号的射击都会击中该射击道中的第一个目标，而每次偶数编号的射击都会错过该射击道中的第一个目标，并击中第二个目标(如果存在)。第一次射击的编号为 1$$$1$$$。
Tim 不允许进行无法击中任何目标的射击，因为这会损坏目标后面的墙。请帮助 Tim 找到一个能够击落所有目标的射击序列，或者说明不存在这样的序列。

input.ai: 每个测试包含多个测试用例。第一行包含一个整数 t$$$t$$$ (1≤t≤1000)$$$(1 \leq t \leq 1000)$$$：测试用例的数量。接下来是各个测试用例的描述。
每个测试用例由 2$$$2$$$ 行组成，共有 t$$$t$$$ 个测试用例。第一行包含 N$$$N$$$，表示车道的数量。第二行包含 N$$$N$$$ 个以空格分隔的整数 A1,A2,⋯,An$$$A_1,A_2,\cdots, A_n$$$，表示每条车道中的目标数量。
保证所有测试用例中 Ai$$$A_i$$$ 的总和不超过 5⋅105$$$5\cdot 10^5$$$。
保证所有测试用例中 N$$$N$$$ 的总和不超过 3⋅105$$$3 \cdot 10^5$$$。

output.ai: 对于每个测试用例，如果存在能够击中每个目标的射击序列，则输出 "YES"；如果不存在这样的序列，则输出 "NO"。答案可以使用任意大小写形式（大写或小写）。例如，字符串 "yEs"、"yes"、"Yes" 和 "YES" 都会被识别为肯定回答。

令 A$$$A$$$ 表示该测试用例中 Ai$$$A_i$$$ 的总和(注意，不同测试用例中的 A$$$A$$$ 可能不同)。如果存在这样的序列，请在单独一行输出一个由 A$$$A$$$ 个以空格分隔的整数 l1,l2,⋯,lA$$$l_1,l_2,\cdots, l_A$$$ 组成的序列，其中 li$$$l_i$$$ 表示 Wabbit 应在第 i$$$i$$$ 次射击时开火的车道。如果有多种解，输出任意一种即可。
如果 YES/NO 的回答正确，但提供的 li$$$l_i$$$ 值不正确，则每个子任务可获得 50%$$$50\%$$$ 的分数。对于每个测试用例，你必须恰好输出 A$$$A$$$ 个 li$$$l_i$$$ 的值，才能获得部分分数。
(70$$$70$$$ 分)：没有额外的约束条件。

note.ai: 在第一个测试用例中，只有 1$$$1$$$ 条通道，其中有 3$$$3$$$ 个目标。Wabbit 可以在第 1$$$1$$$ 条通道开 3 枪，击倒所有目标。假设目标从前到后依次为 A、B$$$A,B$$$ 和 C$$$C$$$，第一枪会击倒 A$$$A$$$，第二枪会打空 B$$$B$$$ 并击倒 C$$$C$$$，最后一枪会击倒 B$$$B$$$。
在第二个测试用例中，只有 1$$$1$$$ 条通道，其中有 2$$$2$$$ 个目标。在第 1$$$1$$$ 条通道开第一枪会命中前面的目标，但第二枪会打空，无法击倒剩下的目标。因此，这个测试用例不存在可行的射击顺序。
在第三个测试用例中，有 5$$$5$$$ 条通道，每条通道各有 1$$$1$$$ 个目标。在任意一条通道开第一枪都会命中该通道的目标，但第二枪无法命中其他目标。因此，这个测试用例不存在可行的射击顺序。
